question: 4 men can do a piece of work in 27 days. How many men will do it in 18 days?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Men × Days = constant

4 × 27 = M × 18

M = (4 × 27) ÷ 18

= 108 ÷ 18 = 6

**∴ Answer = 6 men**
